question: Will a CDC Epi-Aid investigation of Pennsylvania's measles outbreak be underway as of October 1, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo as of 2026-09-21 is a pending, explicitly conditional Epi-Aid request (PA letter Sept 16) that HHS publicly refused to process on Sept 19 ('not through normal channels', 'will not submit to political blackmail'). The unconditional mechanism base rate is high — CDC runs ~80 Epi-Aids/yr and approves/deploys within days of a formal written invitation (TX, SC, VA, KS, NM, WI all got one) — but the relevant conditional class is publicly entrenched federal-state health standoffs resolving within ~2 weeks, which is low: both sides have made opposing public commitments, and CDC still had not acknowledged the four deaths in its Sept 17-18 weekly update. YES needs, in 10 days, a CDC climbdown on death reporting, PA unilaterally dropping its condition, or CDC accepting the conditioned request days after branding it blackmail. Partial offset: the state said Sept 21 that 'talks with CDC about the scope of that help are ongoing', and CDC has an optics incentive to accept and claim the high ground; acceptance alone resolves YES even if PA later rescinds. No human market prices this contract (Manifold empty; Kalshi/Polymarket only have national case-count markets).
